name: Refit Filters (Weapon Class)
author: Starficz; weapon class filter by Sztarek
description: Adds additional filters to the refit weapon picker. This fork adds a Weapon Class filter row whose buttons are built from the weapons you own (fleet cargo, plus local storage when docked). Replaces Refit Filters: enable one or the other, not both. If both are enabled, this fork disables itself.
